resources.full_inference_cost_basis: measured bounded smoke before scheduling remaining cores

scope.halo_mask: M0 in every mode, including overlaps with another DEV core

mask_modes.M0: original P3 positive intervals lowercase; remaining reference sequence uppercase
mask_modes.MW: M0 plus every known all-positive complete original candidate gap in this record's own DEV core
mask_modes.MP: M0 plus comparator-positive bp inside all original candidate gaps in this record's own DEV core; unknown bp unchanged

predictor.name: Tiberius
predictor.weights: exact assets referenced by the pinned mammalia_softmasking_v2 configuration; record resolved local paths before inference

runtime_smoke.selection: first original DEV candidate sorted by gap_start and ID, no gene selection
runtime_smoke.extract_context: center on candidate gap midpoint, shift only to remain within owner halo

cds_chain_evaluation.identity: seqid, strand, ordered exact CDS interval chain

owner_and_boundary_policy.coordinate_conversion: convert record-relative predicted CDS coordinates to genomic coordinates first
owner_and_boundary_policy.owner: the DEV core containing the minimum genomic CDS start of the distinct chain
owner_and_boundary_policy.complete_chain_requirement: all CDS intervals must be contained in the owner record's halo
owner_and_boundary_policy.boundary_incomplete: report separately and exclude from primary chain denominator
owner_and_boundary_policy.halo_duplicates: retain only the record whose core owns the chain; deduplicate identical chains there

cds_chain_evaluation.mp_minus_mw_interpretation: joint change in added material coverage and action resolution, not resolution alone

decision.engineering_pass: valid mask coordinates and ownership, identical sequence letters, active softmask input and successful bounded inference
